# ContourSurfaceGLElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasContourSurfaceGLElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourSurfaceGL.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourSurfaceGL.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasContourSurfaceGL.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasGLSurface`](UltraCanvasGLSurface.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A scalar field: isolines and filled bands, or a shaded 3D height field

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasContourSurfaceGLElement> CreateContourSurfaceGLElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasContourSurfaceGLElement(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
